Cluck Cluck#000.src: Have you taken care of Cluckles yet? If you can't find him, I hid him in my basement.

Cluck Cluck#001.src: You need to be Farming Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.

Cluck Cluck#002.src: Sometimes I wish animals could respawn... hey! What are you doing here? Go away!

Cluck Cluck#004.src: Hey, you aren't a chicken! Wait, you're a human! You can help me! Maybe you are the guy who helped my brother Yahya, but who knows, you humans all look the same to me.
Cluck Cluck#004.dst: ¡Eh, tú no eres un pollo! ¡Espera, eres humano! ¡Puedes ayudarme! Quizá seas el que ayudó a mi hermano Yahya, pero quién sabe, para mí todos los humanos sois iguales.
Cluck Cluck#004.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#005.src: I really love my chickens, but there is one that I just cannot control...
Cluck Cluck#005.dst: Quiero muchísimo a mis pollos, pero hay uno al que no consigo controlar...
Cluck Cluck#005.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#006.src: His name is Cluckles, he was given to me by a man named Bob before he went to war, but when Bob never came back, Cluckles got angry...
Cluck Cluck#006.dst: Se llama Cluckles, me lo dio un hombre llamado Bob antes de irse a la guerra, pero como Bob nunca volvió, Cluckles se enfadó...
Cluck Cluck#006.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#007.src: He's really dangerous to keep on my lovely island, so I keep him in my basement...
Cluck Cluck#007.dst: Es muy peligroso tenerlo en mi preciosa isla, así que lo guardo en el sótano...
Cluck Cluck#007.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#008.src: I want to take care of him, but my wife says it's too dangerous. Where's my wife you say? Oh, I think she's around here eating some grain.
Cluck Cluck#008.dst: Quiero cuidar de él, pero mi mujer dice que es muy peligroso. ¿Que dónde está mi mujer? Ah, creo que anda por aquí comiendo grano.
Cluck Cluck#008.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#009.src: Anyway, I need you to go down there and... Take care of him for me. I would really appreciate it.
Cluck Cluck#009.dst: En fin, necesito que bajes ahí y... te ocupes de él por mí. Te lo agradecería muchísimo.
Cluck Cluck#009.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#010.src: Bring back [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] to Nohno.
Cluck Cluck#010.dst: Llévale [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] a Nohno.

Cluck Cluck#011.src: What is this?! His feather? What did you do to Cluckles?! I wanted you to take care of him, not kill him!
Cluck Cluck#011.dst: ¿Qué es esto? ¿Su pluma? ¿Qué le has hecho a Cluckles? ¡Quería que te ocuparas de él, no que lo mataras!
Cluck Cluck#011.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#012.src: You monster! Leave this place now, and keep that feather to remind you of your hideous crime!
Cluck Cluck#012.dst: ¡Monstruo! ¡Vete de aquí ahora mismo, y quédate esa pluma para que te recuerde tu crimen atroz!
Cluck Cluck#012.speaker: Nohno
